svg.text: Make 4, identical. Plate 76 x 142 mm with a 34.5 mm hole 82 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one end, centred across the width: the headset cup spigot.

svg.text: Two rows of slots 53 mm apart (the post plates' tabs), two 9 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one under the knuckle head tube and one on top; each cup's flange

svg.text: holds its plate against the tube end. The flange bears 2.5 mm inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the post plates, so the wheel load goes straight into them.
